## What

Every LOW/info item from the operator handoff (`findings-note.md`, ticket
`277_R6LOW.1__low-catchall.md`) re-verified at tip `d24dbed8`, then: **9 cheap-safe fixes landed
in-ticket, 10 items BL-rowed (BL-115…BL-124), 1 refuted, 1 covered, the not-Rhēma set left to 274's

**Fixed in-ticket**

- **Recipient email out of logs** (RH-A1-6): the worker `auth.mail` drop line logs the job id, never
  the mailbox.
- **Resend `Idempotency-Key`** (RH-A1-7): `MailSender.send` gained `idempotencyKey`;
  `handleMailSendJob` passes `mail.send:<deliveryId>`; `auth.mail` passes `auth.mail:<job.id>`;
  `ResendMailSender` forwards it (resend@6.26 `CreateEmailRequestOptions`); Resend errors now throw
  the bounded `res.error.name` code.
- **Provenance SHA floor** (RH-A4-5): `check-deploy-provenance.mjs` requires ≥7 chars on both sides
  of the prefix match and gates the REQ-ENG-8 drift arm on the same floor — truncated `build.gitSha`
  values fail closed.
- **Licence exceptions verify the recorded licence** (RH-A4-4): a relicense/missing-licence on an
  excepted package fails the gate instead of passing name-only. Real gate still green (873 pkgs).
- **`slo.probe`** (N-A6 #4/#9): `setInterval` → pg-boss `slo.probe` (queue + work + `*/5` schedule);
  `error` readings log `[slo] probe-error` per tick; `slo.ts` stores `errorSummary` — never
  `e.message`.
- **Retention-backup test** (N-A6 #7): asserts real `boss.work` bindings in `main.ts` (was: string
  presence in the stale 20-name `WORKER_QUEUES` manifest — re-synced to the live 34).
- **`billing-read.mjs` LB undercount** (N-C2): inbound+outbound data processing priced;
  Logging/Monitoring an explicit NOT-PRICED line.
- **Docs drift** (RH-A4-3): `docs/ci.md` + `journeys.yml`×2 deployed-SHA pinning, `ci.yml` S3→GCS,
  `check-licenses.mjs` false fallback claim removed, `ADR-068` dated amendment (`page.evaluate`, not
  `addScriptTag`).
- **Raw error text outside the ADR-053 formatter** (N-C5): new `errorSummary`/`errorLogValue` in
  `@rhema/contracts` (sanitized class + bounded `code`/`constraint`/`routine`/`syscall` tags +
  message-stripped frames); ~20 `console.error(err)`/`err.message` sinks converted across
  api/worker/live-clients — the `claims_draft_id_fkey` diagnostic class survives while messages never
  reach Error Reporting headers. Residual thrown-message bounds → BL-124.

**Refuted:** invite over-redemption (the consume path has been one atomic `used_count < max_uses`
CTE since PRB.01 — agent misread).
